title: The whole component path is played again, now that it has versions and knobs
goal: Component design is the feature in focus, and it has grown a lot in four days: versions, a number you can hand a copy, room on four sides, placing a particular version off the shelf, and carrying one change to every version at once. The last time anyone played the whole path as one sitting was 2026-09-03, before any of that landed. Play it again from nothing, as somebody who has never seen the app: draw a control, make it a component, give it a version and a knob, place three copies, override one, change the original, and put the override back. Then say honestly where it is clumsy.
notes: Follow-on from author-a-component-and-reuse-it-start-to-finish (done 2026-09-03, walk Scripts/playtest/component-end-to-end-walk.json, audit queue/audits/2026-09-03-component-end-to-end.json). Shipped since then and not covered by that walk: a-component-can-hold-more-than-one-version-of-it, a-knob-can-be-a-number (audit 2026-09-06-a-knob-can-be-a-number), room-that-differs-side-to-side-can-be-a-knob (2026-09-06-uneven-room-knob), a-copy-can-have-its-own-room-inside (2026-09-06-component-own-room), place-a-copy-of-a-particular-version-straight-fr (2026-09-06-place-a-version), a-change-can-be-made-to-every-version-of-a-compo (2026-09-06-apply-to-versions), the-dock-opens-on-the-section-that-answers-the-la (2026-09-06-dock-component-first). Filed by the 2026-09-07 digest design review: eight pieces shipped, eight one-feature audits, and no audit anyone could hand a first-time user. Known rough spots to watch for on the way through, from those audits: a knob cannot reach the original's own outermost group; a copy's Version row and knobs sit above Position and Size now, so check the panel still reads in a sensible order; the properties panel may not fit (the-properties-panel-fits-on-the-screen-it-has).
acceptance: One scripted walk drives the whole path end to end and passes twice in a row
It covers the pieces added since 2026-09-03: a second version, a number knob, room as a knob, placing a named version off the shelf, and carrying a change to every version
Every step is checked by what is actually on screen, not by the walk saying it pressed something
One undo puts back each step that claims to be one step
An audit under queue/audits/ that a person could follow with no other reading, with real captures at each turn
The audit says plainly what a first-time user would get wrong, and each of those becomes its own task
The 2026-09-03 walk and audit are either updated or retired, so there is one current answer and not two
